title: Cake, die Süße!
description: In this mod, unite with Cake through custom interactions, making your Minecraft world more heartfelt!
body:
## Quick Question:
Are you ready to bring some sweetness into your Minecraft world? With the "Cake, die Süße!" mod, you can interact with Cake in the most adorable ways possible!

## Features:
💖 Press Y to Open the Interaction Menu
![The interaction menu.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a73e4de1a9d760016eb54010f5f157ea9f4afe28_0.webp)

## Goofy Ahh Menu
The menu presents three charming actions to express your affection for Cake:
- Küssen (Kiss): Choose this, and you'll see the heartwarming message, "Du hast Cake geküsst." 🥰
- Umarmen (Hug): Select this option, and you'll be greeted with another sweet message, "Du hast Cake umarmt." 🤗
- Kuscheln (Cuddle): Basically the same as Umarmen (honestly I don't know what's the difference between hugging and cuddling), and you'll see yet another sweet message, "Du hast Cake gekuschelt." 🤗
- Sprechen (Talk): Rizz up Cake by clicking one of the options by choosing from these messages:
  - "Ich liebe dich sehr" (I love you very much).
  - "Ich liebe dich sehr" (I love you very much).
  - "Du bist so schön" (You are so beautiful).
"Ich vermisse dich" (I miss you).
![Rizzing in progress...](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/94af8a344d3625c8e3e409ba6ca571f2d5a45ffd_0.webp)

## What are you waiting for?
Bring Cake to Life!
Whether you're spreading love or simply adding a touch of romance to your Minecraft adventures, this mod is all about making your world sweeter and cuter.

Download now and make every moment with Cake unforgettable!
